sourceFile: 54.BRS-161014 Report test new Frame improvement type C_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but changed-factor grouping and several outcome extractions are not reliable enough for final use.
issues: Primary change should likely be Normal Frame vs Type C improved frame, not mixed TEST plus cavities.
Cavities A-G are subgroup keys, not changed conditions.
Function outcome omits Normal baseline row 73, so comparison is incomplete.
Drop-test pairing uses wrong normal row for the 2023-10-28 test and omits row 83.
Measurement outcomes include header/summary rows as numeric stats, producing nonsensical values.
correctionPlan: Redefine changed factor as Type C improved frame versus Normal Frame, with cavity as subgroup.
Separate TEST label in drop test as the improved-frame condition only if supported by context.
Add Normal function baseline row 73 and compare against Type C total and/or cavity subgroups.
Fix drop-test pairs to 80-81 and 82-83 by date.
Remove bogus measurement stats from header rows and rebuild height results from actual data rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they are semantically insufficient until missing baseline and incorrect table citations are corrected.
